class.name: IfcPostalAddress
class.brief_description: Definition: The address for delivery of paper based mail. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x.

members.member: An organization defined address for internal mail delivery. A String, or null when unset.

The postal address. NOTE: A postal address may occupy several lines (or elements) when recorded. It is expected that normal usage will incorporate relevant elements of the following address concepts: A location within a building (e.g. 3rd Floor) Building name (e.g. Interoperability House) Street number (e.g. 6400) Street name (e.g. Alliance Boulevard). Typical content of address lines may vary in different countries. A PackedStringArray, or null when unset.
An address that is implied by an identifiable mail drop. A String, or null when unset.
The name of a town. A String, or null when unset.
The name of a region. NOTE: The counties of the United Kingdom and the states of North America are examples of regions. A String, or null when unset.
The code that is used by the country's postal service. A String, or null when unset.
The name of a country. A String, or null when unset.
